name: io.github.VnKk8/fastqa-mcp
title: FastQA MCP
description: Browser QA for AI agents: whole tests in one call, finds and explains hidden bugs, CI replay.

environmentVariables.name: FASTQA_HEADED
environmentVariables.description: Show the browser window instead of running it hidden.

environmentVariables.name: FASTQA_COOKIES
environmentVariables.description: What every page that opens does with a cookie banner: leave it, accept it or reject it.

environmentVariables.name: FASTQA_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long one step waits for the page, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: FASTQA_QUALITY
environmentVariables.description: How findings are handled: observe reports them, strict also fails a replay on them, off disables them.

environmentVariables.name: FASTQA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for saved flows, reports, files to upload and settings.
